name: Sarisha Designer Sarees
tagline: Silk sarees, designer blouses and salwar suits
hours: 10 am to 8:30 pm, Monday to Saturday. Sunday 11 am to 7 pm.
about:
Sarisha Designer Sarees is a saree and salwar suit shop for silk sarees, kalamkari, ikat, Kerala kasavu, hand embroidered sarees and designer blouses.
This is a demo catalogue built by OneCatalog to show how a saree shop looks in one link. Open a saree, then tap the WhatsApp button to ask about it.
WhatsApp messages from this demo come to OneCatalog. The address and timings are examples.
metaHeadline: Designer Sarees, Blouses and Salwar Suits
metaDescription: Sarisha Designer Sarees demo catalogue. Silk, kalamkari, ikat and embroidered sarees, designer blouses and salwar suits. Enquire on WhatsApp.

categoryIntros.Silk and Fine Sarees: Silk sarees with gold borders, from Kerala kasavu to deep maroon temple borders and soft organza. Made for weddings, pooja and festivals.
categoryIntros.Embroidered Sarees: Sarees with hand embroidery, flowers, lotus borders and fine thread work. A rich look without a heavy drape.
categoryIntros.Printed and Handloom Sarees: Kalamkari, ikat and checked sarees in cotton and silk cotton. Easy to wear every day and good for the office.
categoryIntros.Designer Blouses: Blouses with zari, beads and fine embroidery, in shapes that suit a silk saree.
categoryIntros.Salwar Suits and Fabrics: Embroidered salwar suit pieces and plain fabric, ready to stitch to your size.
